# P26.12 — Federal surveillance legislation via Congress.gov (SOURCES.11)

The federal companion to P26.11's state sweep: a bounded, keyword-filtered
**Congress.gov v3 bill-index sweep** over the 119th Congress — keyed by the
existing `sig-data-gov-key` (api.data.gov, `X-Api-Key` header, never the URL)
— emitting typed, evidence-backed claims for surveillance-relevant federal
bills and resolutions: title, latest action/status, chamber, congress,
jurisdiction, external id, conventional identifier, and the matched keyword
— with the derived congress.gov public record URL, a locator into the
captured page, and the **verbatim** matched literal as `raw_value`.

A federal bill or resolution is **proposed law** — it emits a
`legislative_bill` entity row + `bill_*` claims and is **never** promoted to
a §11.14 `LegalInstrument`; no enactment is inferred from identifier, title,
status, latest action, or presence in the index (§3.1).

## What landed

- **`congress_gov_plan.toml`** (new, versioned `2026.09.18`) — the whole
  sweep as data: `congresses = [119]` (the current session), the
  congress-scoped `/bill/{congress}` endpoint (the `congress` query param on
  `/v3/bill` is ignored — verified live), `per_page = 250` (the verified v3
  bound), `sort = "updateDate+desc"` (sent for the record — observed
  non-functional, nothing depends on list order), and
  `max_pages_per_congress = 96` — the hard bound that **truncates loud** via
  a `truncated` flag on the page's `bill_query` outcome row; the sweep never
  crawls past it. Every live-verified recon finding is recorded in the plan
  header.
- **`legislation_vocab.toml`** → `2026.09.18.2` — the shared P26.11 set plus
  two federal terms: **`fisa_702`** (FISA / Foreign Intelligence
  Surveillance Act / Section 702 / Title VII / 702 reauthorization) and
  **`government_surveillance`** (government/mass/warrantless surveillance,
  surveillance reform/transparency/accountability/state) — covering every
  ticket-named federal phrase. Matching stays **local verbatim** — the
  Congress.gov bill list has no keyword query, and the verbatim scan is the
  match of record.
- **`sources.toml`** — `congress_gov` registered (186 → 187) and **flipped**
  (`ingestion_permitted`, 65 → 66 loadable) under GL-GATE-06: Congress.gov
  bill/resolution metadata is a US federal government work → public domain
  (17 U.S.C. §105) → `CC0-1.0`; the api.data.gov README states the purpose
  verbatim ("view, retrieve, and re-use machine-readable data"). Packet:
  `docs/build/reports/rights/congress_gov.md`. The key is auth, not the
  rights basis (HG-09).
- **`accountability.py`** — the federal layer of the P26.11 legislation
  path: `congress_gov_config()`/`congress_gov_plan()` accessors;
  `congress_gov_bills` parse kind failing closed on `{"error":…}` envelopes,
  malformed JSON, and non-`bills` payloads (`ContentDrift`, an empty list is
  an honest empty page); keyed `X-Api-Key` fetch from `$SIG_DATA_GOV_KEY`
  only — the key never touches a URL, so no credential lands in source_uri
  or run rows; `discover_more` expands each seed page's `pagination.count`
  into the remaining `/bill/{congress}?offset=N` pages — numeric offset
  order, per-congress 96-page bound, deduped by URL, one bounded pass (a
  generated page never re-expands); `normalize` emits `bill_external_id`
  (`{congress}-{type}-{number}`), `bill_identifier` (typed conventional
  citation `S. 1355` + verbatim `S 1355` raw via the reviewed
  `type_prefixes` map — unmapped types fall back verbatim),
  `bill_title`, `bill_session`, `bill_jurisdiction` (`United States
  Congress`), **`bill_chamber`** (new federal predicate — the
  chamber-of-origin a state bill does not surface), `bill_status` +
  `bill_status_date` (the record's own `latestAction` verbatim), and
  `bill_matched_keyword` with the verbatim literal + byte-range-into-title
  locator. Unmatched bills keep the `index_only` `primary_record` evidence
  link. Per-page `bill_query` outcome rows (congress, page_offset, outcome,
  counts, `truncated`, plan/vocab versions) ride `document_outcomes`.
- **Claims carry no volatile field** — no `observed_at`, no retrieval
  timestamp, no capture id keys a claim (SIG-INGEST-003/017). Claim identity
  is stable bill content → an unchanged record digests identically on ANY
  re-run; the P26.11 `claim_observed_not_future` defect cannot recur.
- **Wiring** — `live_targets.toml` seed page (`rate_limit_per_min = 30`, far
  inside the documented 5,000 requests/hour); `api_allowlist.toml`
  `api.congress.gov /v3`; `ops/cadence.toml` monthly `0 5 3 * 2` Etc/UTC +
  `secrets = { SIG_DATA_GOV_KEY = "sig-data-gov-key" }` secret binding; `runner.py`
  `congress_gov → accountability` map + `congress`/`page_offset` outcome
  fields.
- **Fixtures** — the REAL captured 250-bill 119th-Congress page-1 response
  (`congress_gov_bill119_p1.json`) + a synthetic FISA page.

## Verification

**Deterministic — `make check` green** (lint, format, mypy × 231 files,
3302 tests, verify-gen):

- 23 new sweep tests + credential-transport coverage: plan bounds
  (per_page ≤ 250, congresses=[119], ≤96 pages), every ticket-named federal
  term in the vocabulary, bounded `discover_more` expansion (count 18,887 →
  75 pages; count 99,999 → capped; a generated page never re-expands; drift
  loud), typed claims (typed+verbatim identifier, chamber, session,
  jurisdiction, verbatim latest-action, byte-range keyword locators,
  derived public URL), never a `LegalInstrument`, `index_only` fallback,
  the real page → 250 index links + honest `empty`/`truncated` outcome,
  `bill_query` fields, fail-closed envelopes, no volatile claim fields,
  digest stability, `X-Api-Key`-only credential transport.

**Live — hosted `sig-ingest-congress-gov`**
(`sig-api@sha256:de76f1e1…`, Cloud Build `2329e6df`, linux/amd64 — local
Docker unresponsive again; per-job upserts on the user account, ADC corrupt
as recorded since P26.8; `roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor` granted to the
compute SA on `sig-data-gov-key` — the verbatim pattern the other keyed
secrets carry):

- **Exec `slrlw`** (161.7s): `outcome=ok` — **76 page captures** of the
  119th-Congress index (**18,929 bills indexed**), **72 bills matched** →
  19,653 emitted records → **+648 spine claims** (72 × 9 predicates),
  231,576 → 232,224. Zero rate-limit events, zero refusals, zero
  disappearances, zero drift. Per-term page hits: drone 29, fisa_702 9,
  government_surveillance 7, body_worn_camera 4, facial_recognition 3,
  cell_site_simulator 2, surveillance_ordinance 1.
- **Exec `7jzqm`** (157.6s): **idempotent rerun** — identical 76 capture
  digests, identical emitted records → **+0 claim rows** (232,224
  unchanged). Content-keyed dedup proven live.
- Scheduler `sig-sched-congress-gov` ENABLED on the monthly cron; run rows
  WORM at `gs://…-sig-restricted/ops/runs/congress_gov/2026-09-18/`;
  committed fetch records
  `live_runs/2026-09-18_congress_gov_p2612{,_rerun}.json`.
- **Quota posture:** 152 requests total across both executions — far inside
  the documented 5,000/hour window. **No deferral opened.**
